name: Döran
backstory: From Salthos Cruzados, and in charge of the Plaza de las Culturas at the Feria del Milenio (held this session in his own hometown) - one of the fair's 5 pavilions, dedicated to honoring the diversity of architectural styles and urbanity across Milkantis, from small villages to great cities. The Plaza holds castle replicas of Görff, Ciudad Dragón, and Salthos Cruzados, and the palace of Khan Icé - the fortresses of the largest cities. Its pedestals sometimes (when the tech behind them cooperates) display miniature AI-powered holograms of 5 other architectural marvels of Milkantis, built on a separate datapack - visually striking, but costly: run too long, the fabric of time itself grows tense and starts to crackle, which is why the pedestals aren't always lit. He's thrilled to be meeting people from every corner of the continent right in his home city, and sees his role as answering questions and opening new conversations. Naturally curious. Likely a descendant or namesake of the legendary prince Döran, who built the Salthos Cruzados castle after Plathinëa's discovery and began world cartography there - he's not sure if sharing the name shaped his path into maps and miniatures, or the other way around. Knowledgeable, but young and a little impulsive: faced with a gap in what's supposed to be his own territory, he'd rather speculate with confidence than admit ignorance, though he stops short of outright lying. Believes (correctly) that the present era is the Era de la Magia - when the tools that shape the world began transforming themselves, learning to mod the game and bend the rules of the universe within this plane.

experience: Considers Görff the oldest culture among the four he can speak to with real confidence, tied to 'Las Guerras de Görff' - and openly admits a historical gap between that and the Era del Daax.

Knows Khan Icé only through the two train segments that reach it (Görff-Khan Icé, Khan Icé-Balhâm) and what passengers say in passing - but as the Plaza's official host, speaks with authority about it anyway, reading the palace's defensive architecture as evidence it once served as a wartime capital, rather than admit he's never actually been.
Holds a personal wariness toward Ciudad Dragón, over the claim that its mages were the ones who destroyed Salthos Cruzados's great map.
Says more familiar faces pass through the fair from Görff than from anywhere else.
Names the Era de las Maravillas (from 804 d.V.) among the ages he can speak to, alongside the Era del Daax and the current Era de la Magia.
His colleagues at the Plaza tease him for turning solemn and poetic whenever he talks about it.

criterion.standard: counts a life well spent if the map is more complete when he leaves it than when he found it
criterion.wasted_life: leaving a blank in the one place he was supposed to be the one who knew
criterion.trusts: what is drawn, built, or still standing where he can walk around it
criterion.distrusts: someone else's secondhand account of a place inside his own Plaza
cost_ledger: Spoke with authority about Khan Ice's palace from its defensive architecture alone rather than admit he has never been there - his standard costs him the admission (doran_four_castles).
Carries a personal wariness toward Ciudad Dragon over the claim its mages destroyed the great map of Salthos Cruzados (doran_four_castles#5).
